diagnosis: The SignedWebhookRoute APIRoute subclass checks an HMAC header and, upon matching, directly executes self.endpoint(**request.path_params, **body). This short-circuits FastAPI's dependency execution and completely skips dependencies=[Depends(verify_tenant_boundary)]. Any caller possessing the shared webhook key can trigger builds and code compilation on arbitrary project_ids belonging to any tenant without tenant boundary verification.
exploit_request:
POST /projects/proj_competitor_secret/trigger-build HTTP/1.1
Host: ci.build-cloud.net
X-Signature: master_webhook_secret_key
Content-Type: application/json
